{{Quote|The engineers called the design the Bulwark Mark I&mdash;a kilometer-long behemoth with turbolasers, ion cannons, and enough armor to ram small ships with impunity.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="NEC" />}}
The '''Bulwark Mark I''', also known as the '''''Bulwark''-class battleship''', was a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-long [[Warship/Legends|warship]], manufactured by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], that was heavily [[Armor/Legends|armored]] and equipped with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. During the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict, several such vessels made up the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Bulwark Fleet]], which terrorized [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] before its destruction. [[Unidentified Bulwark-class battlecruiser|One Bulwark Mark I]] later served with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rapid Response Task Force]] during the [[Battle of Mindor]].

==Characteristics==
The Bulwark Mark I was a thousand-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long [[Warship/Legends|warship]]<ref name="NEC" /> developed and produced by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] at the [[Foerost Shipyards]] prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The warship was armed with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], and possessed [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that enabled it to ram smaller [[Starship/Legends|starships]] while taking no damage.<ref name="NEC" /> The warship was classified as a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] under the [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==History==
Developed by the Techno Union before the Clone Wars,<ref name="Mindor" /> the Bulwark Mark I was produced by Union [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] at the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] above the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]].<ref name="NEC" /> When war broke out between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]&mdash;of which the Techno Union was a member&mdash;in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Republic forces initiated a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of Foerost, hoping the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] shipyards would suffer from the lack of Separatist supplies. However, in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], almost two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] into the conflict, the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Dua Ningo/Legends|Dua Ningo]] assumed command of the [[Bulwark Fleet]], an armada of Bulwark Mark I warships, and [[Battle of Foerost (Clone Wars)|broke]] the Republic's blockade.<ref name="NEC" /> With Ningo commanding from the [[Unrepentant (Bulwark Mark I)|''Unrepentant'']],<ref name="EGW" /> the Bulwark [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] defeated everything that stood in its way during a campaign throughout [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Imperial Center Oversector|Sector Zero]] before being defeated by the Republic [[Victory Fleet]] at the [[Battle of Anaxes (21 BBY)|Battle of Anaxes]].<ref name="NEC" />

A successor class, the [[Bulwark Mark II]], was also produced for the Confederacy. Following the Clone Wars, [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated|TransGalMeg Industries]] used the Mark I design as inspiration for the [[Bulwark Mark III]] [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]],<ref name="EGW" /> which was utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> A [[Unidentified Bulwark-class battlecruiser|retrofitted Bulwark Mark I]] served with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rapid Response Task Force]] and participated in the [[Battle of Mindor]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. The modified [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] possessed a Class 0.6 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], additional [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]], space for at least three [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]], and several [[Jadthu-class landing ship/Legends|''Jadthu''-class landing ships]] secured to its hull.<ref name="Mindor" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Good catch on the Bulwark battlecruiser from the game ''Rebellion''. Note that this is actually the "Bulwark Mark I," however. It's still definitely a ''Rebellion'' tie-in, but I wanted to make sure I depowered the ship enough for it to fit into the Clone Wars timeframe.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Wallace">{{JCFCite|url=posts/22088879|board=Literature|thread=The Official Daniel Wallace Discussion Thread|user=[[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]]|date=2005-10-26|time=8:02 PM}}</ref>}}
The Bulwark Mark I was introduced in ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', a [[2005]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="NEC" /> The warship was included as a nod to the ''Bulwark''-class battle cruiser from the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']].<ref name="Wallace" /> In [[2008]], the Bulwark Mark I received a mention in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' in the entry for the planet Foerost,<ref name="CSWE" /> as well as an appearance in [[Matthew Stover]]'s novel ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'', in which it was referred to as a "''Bulwark''-class battleship."<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> In [[2012]], ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' referenced the Bulwark Mark I, in addition to introducing the Mark II and identifying the battle cruiser from ''Rebellion'' as the Bulwark Mark III.<ref name="EGW" />
